CVE-2026-16554 is an integer overflow in print_string_ptr() when size_t is 32 bits. DHI builds this package only for 64-bit linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, where size_t is 8 bytes and the escape_characters counter cannot wrap at the reported threshold.

The DHI cJSON package patches CVE-2026-67217 by backporting the JSON Patch atomicity fix as dhi-cve-2026-67217-apply-patch-atomicity.patch. The patch validates the required replace value and the move source and destination parent before deleting or detaching any member, so a malformed operation returns an error without partially mutating the target document.

The DHI cJSON package patches CVE-2026-67216 by backporting the object-comparison complexity fix as dhi-cve-2026-67216-compare-object-members.patch. The patched cJSON_Compare() first verifies equal member counts and then performs one recursive object walk, eliminating the second traversal that caused exponential CPU use for deeply nested equal documents.

The DHI cJSON package patches CVE-2026-67215 by backporting the recursive-duplication depth fix as dhi-cve-2026-67215-circular-limit-duplicate-depth.patch. The patch caps cJSON_Duplicate recursion at CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT (1000), matching the parser nesting bound and preventing deeply nested JSON Patch copy/add operations from exhausting the thread stack.

The DHI cJSON package patches CVE-2026-29036 by backporting the JSON Pointer decoding fix as dhi-cve-2026-29036-decode-pointer-inplace.patch. The patched decode_pointer_inplace() correctly consumes RFC 6901 ~0 and ~1 escape sequences and preserves unescaped bytes, so JSON Patch paths resolve to the intended object keys.
